title: Align session policy and compact stream facade for parity across SDKs
author: Maya Chen
description:
Context: The TypeScript and Python SDKs recently converged on a small set of session lifecycle primitives (session lease, heartbeat, and deterministic refresh windows) and a compact streaming facade (pull-style iterator + pause/resume hooks). The Go SDK lagged in ergonomic surface area and had divergent config names (CredWindow vs. SessionWindow) and inconsistent backoff profiles. Motivation: unify naming, defaults, and runtime behavior so cross-language teams can reason about token refresh, session affinity, and stream pause semantics consistently across client stacks. What this PR does: 1) Introduces a SessionPolicy struct that centralizes refresh_window, lease_ttl, heartbeat_interval, and backoff_profile; mirrors TS/Python field names and defaults. 2) Adds a compact StreamFacade (pull iterator + Context-aware Pause/Resume) that follows the same API shape as other SDKs: NewStreamFacade(ctx, opts) -> StreamIterator. 3) Refactors existing session factory to accept SessionPolicy and emit a SessionLease object with Renew/Release methods. 4) Harmonizes backoff profiles with the canonical profiles defined in internal/retry/profiles.go and exposes an option to pass custom profiles. 5) Small ergonomic helpers: WithSessionPolicy(ctx, policy), StreamOptions.WithAutoRenew(), and a clearer error type StreamError with typed codes for EOF, Cancelled, AuthExpired. 6) Bumps Go SDK minor version to v1.6.1 in CHANGELOG and module files.
Migration notes:
- Rename old CredWindow config to SessionPolicy.RefreshWindow (backwards compatible shim kept for one minor, with deprecation warning).
- Replace use of LegacyStream with StreamFacade; LegacyStream still works but emits deprecation warnings and will be removed in v1.8.0.
- If you relied on the previous default backoff, pass retry.WithProfile(retry.Legacy) explicitly to maintain behavior.
Testing and validation:
- Unit tests updated/added for session lease lifecycle (session_factory_test.go) and stream resume/pause (stream_facade_test.go).
- Added integration smoke in examples/pullstream.go that runs against local devserver harness.
- CI: ran linux/amd64, linux/arm64 builds and Go race detector on critical tests.
Performance: no measurable regression in microbenchmarks; a modest improvement in long-lived stream memory usage due to smaller iterator state.
Security: token refresh logic unchanged except for consolidated policy; no secrets persisted.
Docs and examples: updated README section "Session management" and added example showing WithSessionPolicy + StreamFacade usage.
Related work: mirrors ENG-3124 and follows patterns in redwood-sdk-typescript#22345 and redwood-sdk-python#176204.
Release notes: see release_notes field.
Rationale: aligning surface area reduces docs and onboarding overhead and prevents subtle cross-lang bugs (mismatch in renew timing caused a small but real flakiness in canary runs).
